title: A LISTENER AT YOUR SIDE KEEPS STRIKING
why: His note of 2026-10-09: Listeners charged him and then did not hurt him, especially when he stood still. A Listener tracks you only by the sound of your feet, so once it reached a man who had stopped moving it heard nothing, waited seven seconds and went dormant right beside him, and a dormant Listener never strikes. Measured on the old build: five blows, then asleep at his side for good. Now a Listener within reach of you keeps track of you whether you stand, crouch or move, and keeps striking. Further away, standing still still makes it lose you, as before. Crawlers were measured too: they bite every 0.7 seconds at your side whether you stand, crouch or move.
now: A Listener that reaches you no longer falls asleep at your side when you stand still. It keeps striking.

edits.anchor: // Recovering from its own blow: it is still coming, but slowly, and that
